back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“What do you mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: ‘The fathers eat sour grapes, but the children's teeth are set on edge’?
As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will no longer have occasion to quote this proverb in Israel.
Behold, every soul is Mine; both the soul of the father and the soul of the son are Mine. The one who sins is the one who will die.
Suppose a man is righteous and does what is just and right:
he does not eat food at the mountain or lift his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor's wife, and does not approach a woman during her menstrual impurity;
he does not oppress anyone, returns the pledge to the debtor, robs no one, gives his food to the hungry, and covers the naked with clothing;
he does not lend at interest or take excess profit, withholds his hand from injustice, and judges fairly between one person and another;
he follows My statutes and faithfully keeps My ordinances. Such a man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord GOD.
Suppose that man has a violent son, a shedder of blood, who does any of these things to a brother,
though the father did none of these things—the son eats food at the mountain and defiles his neighbor's wife,
oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not return a pledge, lifts his eyes to idols, and commits abomination,
lends at interest and takes excess profit. Will such a son live? He will not live! Because he has done all these abominations, he will surely die; his blood will be on his own head.
But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father committed and, having considered them, does not do likewise:
he does not eat food at the mountain or lift his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor's wife,
oppresses no one, retains no pledge, commits no robbery, gives his food to the hungry, and covers the naked with clothing;
he withholds his hand from harming the poor, takes no interest or excess profit, keeps My ordinances and follows My statutes. Such a man will not die for his father's iniquity; he will surely live.
As for his father, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was not good among his people, behold, he will die for his own iniquity.
Yet you ask, ‘Why should the son not bear the iniquity of the father?’ Because the son did what is just and right, kept all My statutes and practiced them, he will surely live.

The one who sins is the one who will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous will be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked will be upon himself.
But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.
None of the transgressions he has committed will be remembered against him anymore; because of the righteousness he has practiced, he will live.
Do I take pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Do I not rather desire that he turn from his ways and live?

But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, committing all the abominations that the wicked do, will he live? None of the righteous deeds he did will be remembered. Because of the treachery and sin he has committed, he will die for them.
Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear now, O house of Israel: Is My way not just? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, and dies for it, he dies because of the evil he has committed.
And when a wicked man turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his own life.
Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ O house of Israel, is My way not just? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge each of you according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not become a stumbling block to you.
Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?
For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live!”
